title: Text requests get a faster default
summary:
Text requests got a faster default, authentication shed redundant queries, and Unfoldtech joined the creative projects.

Text requests that omit a model now default to `openai-fast`; explicitly selected models are unchanged. Configurable routing was also added for specified authenticated users, alongside the `openai-roblox` model and changes to several model tier labels.

Token validation now gets user details in one query instead of three. A test response fell from roughly 12 seconds to 2.1 seconds, and image generation now reuses one authentication result throughout a request.

Unfoldtech, created by kengkreingkrai, was added to Creative Projects. It turns Pexels image inspiration into prompts and generated images, with IPTC metadata embedded in downloads.

highlights.title: Faster default text model
highlights.text: Text requests without a `model` now use `openai-fast`. Explicitly selected models are unchanged. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=openai-fast).
